jobs.description:
Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

As a quality control associate, you will inspect incoming and outgoing goods. You will verify quantities, record data, and follow up on discrepancies in accordance with established procedures. If you identify damage, incorrect products, or incorrect quantities, you will report them and help find a solution. Your meticulous approach ensures that the quality of the goods and the logistics process are maintained.

 

• You work accurately and have an eye for detail

• You can work independently and take initiative when necessary

• You check and record figures quickly and accurately

• You communicate clearly in the event of damage, incorrect products, or discrepancies in quantities

• You can work according to established procedures

• You are available for a permanent late-shift position

• You are comfortable using a tablet

• You have a very good command of English, as communication with the team leader will be in English

Title
Two-Shift All-round Operator
Job description
Ready for a hands-on role in textile manufacturing? Join a two-shift all-round opportunity in Harelbeke. You’ll work with a team at a textile manufacturer producing doormats.
Job duties
• 
Package doormats and follow the packaging schedule.

• 
Make sure pallets, labels, and customer-specific packaging materials are ready at the line.

• 
Set up packaging lines and work with the technician to resolve issues.

• 
Help keep the packaging area clean and orderly.

The role is organized across two shifts.

If you enjoy keeping work organized and taking ownership, this could be a great fit for you.

• At least one year in a similar role gives you a solid foundation to bring to the team.
• You naturally think things through, stay organized, and take responsibility for your work.
• You have your own transportation and can reliably get to work.
• Strong English and Dutch are a plus if you enjoy communicating in both languages.

The employer operates in the food and beverage wholesale sector.

The role is based in Hulshout, Antwerp, Belgium.
Your role
• 
Set up, operate and monitor production machinery to keep the process moving.

• 
Enter and adjust machine parameters, and follow production progress.

• 
Check product quality and ensure items are labelled and packaged correctly.

• 
Resolve minor technical issues and help maintain an efficient process.

• 
Keep your work area clean, orderly and safe.

The working day starts from 07:00.
Company profile
Forum Jobs connects talent and businesses as a full-service HR partner. Its approach is personal, with broad knowledge across sectors and a focus on supporting both candidates and employers. This Production Operator opportunity is shared through that candidate-focused service.

If you enjoy hands-on production work and take pride in getting the details right, you could feel at home in this role.

• 
Production or Operator experience gives you a solid starting point, and technical insight helps you tackle practical problems with confidence.

• 
Very good English feels natural to you; Dutch is a welcome extra.

• 
You bring an accurate, responsible and quality-focused approach to your work.

• 
Flexibility comes easily: you’re open to changing working hours and overtime when needed.

• 
You live in Belgium, have a driving licence and your own transport, and are comfortable working in a temperature-controlled environment of 10–12°C.

Night-Shift Packaging Operator

Ready for a steady night-shift role in textile manufacturing? Join a packaging operation in Harelbeke and help keep production moving through the night.

A textile manufacturing workplaceA company in the textile sector makes products that move through a carefully managed packaging process.

Your role

• 
Package doormats and follow the packaging schedule.

• 
Make sure pallets, labels, and customer-specific packaging materials are ready at the line.

• 
Set up packaging lines and work with the technician to resolve disruptions.

• 
Keep the packaging area clean and orderly.

You’ll work on a fixed night shift.

You may feel at home in this role if you like keeping work organized and taking responsibility for doing it well.

• A year of experience in a similar role gives you a welcome head start.
• Logical thinking and strong organizational skills help you keep tasks clear and moving smoothly.
• You take ownership of your work and bring a dependable, responsible approach to your tasks.
• Your own transportation makes getting to the workplace in Harelbeke easier.
• Strong Dutch and English skills are a welcome plus.

With a strong focus on customer orientation, they provide solutions in the logistics chain. Due to their rapid growth, they are looking for enthusiastic and driven employees who can contribute to their further expansion.

Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

We are looking for a production worker with a good knowledge of English. Are you handy and able to work with a pneumatic nail gun?

For our client, an established company active in the wholesale and distribution sector, we are looking for a Purchase Assistant to join their team in Zaventem.

You will join an international environment where collaboration, efficiency and customer satisfaction are key. In this role, you will support the purchasing and logistics activities, helping to ensure smooth order management and stock follow-up.

Your responsibilities

• Assist with the day-to-day purchasing activities and administrative follow-up.
• Process and monitor purchase orders with suppliers.
• Follow up on deliveries and ensure orders are received on time.
• Monitor stock levels and update relevant information in the company's systems.
• Maintain accurate purchasing and product data.

Your profile

• You are fluent in English and French, both written and spoken.

• You hold a Bachelor's degree or have equivalent experience.

• You are dynamic, proactive and well organized.
• You are stress-resistant and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.occupation: Sales Associate Chocolate – Full-Time - Immediate Start - Bruges
jobs.description:
As a sales associate, you are the first point of contact for customers in an exclusive chocolate and delicatessen store in the heart of Bruges. Your warm welcome and professional advice make all the difference for every visitor. You ensure an attractive store, smooth operations behind the scenes, and a top experience for international guests.

On a typical day, you start by receiving deliveries and restocking the store. You greet customers, explain the product range, and respond to their needs. You keep the store tidy, monitor stock, and work closely with colleagues to smoothly handle busy periods. During holiday seasons, you may close up later, but you always enjoy a varied and rewarding workday.

Would you like to be part of a team that values quality, service, and experience? Apply now and turn your passion for chocolate into your profession!

• You have a well-groomed appearance and radiate enthusiasm

• You speak fluent English

• You have a basic knowledge of Dutch or are willing to learn quickly

• Extra languages such as Spanish, Russian, or Chinese are an asset

• You are structured and detail-oriented

• You are organizationally strong and keep an overview

• You work well in a team

• You are flexible and willing to work weekends (with one day off per weekend, unless covering for a colleague on leave)

• You can work evenings during vacation periods and busy times (store closes at 10 pm, max. 11 late shifts/month)

• You are physically fit and able to handle deliveries

Key hard skills:

• Dutch – spoken and written

• English – spoken and written

• Additional languages are a plus

Sentea is growing, and we are looking for a 
Senior Embedded Software Engineer  to strengthen our team.
 

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will shape the software behind our silicon photonics-based fiber sensor read-out systems. You will work across the complete software stack: from defining the overall architecture to embedded C/C++ on Linux and FPGA firmware, through to network interfaces and Python APIs, and the implementation and validation of our signal processing algorithms.
 

This is a hands-on role for an experienced engineer who enjoys owning a system end to end, works closely with the hardware team, and takes pride in building robust, well-tested software that runs reliably in the field.
 

What will you do?
 

Your role:
 
 

• Define the software architecture of our fiber sensor read-out systems 

• Implement and validate the embedded software and signal-processing algorithms 

• Work closely with the hardware and photonics teams  

Who are we looking for?
 

Ideally, you have:
 
 

• At least 5 years of experience in software development. 

• Strong software engineering practices (version control systems, CI/CD, TDD) 

• Experience programming embedded systems in C/C++ 

• Experience with FPGA design (Verilog, VHDL, HLS, Vivado) 

• Experience with embedded Linux 

• Knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP) and web protocols 

• Knowledge of industrial communication protocols (e.g. Modbus, PROFINET, MQTT, …) is a plus 

• Experience developing APIs in Python 

• Affinity with hardware: you understand electronic circuits and enjoy working with the hardware team 

• Able to work independently 

• Experience with Agile development and project management is a plus 

• Languages: English, Dutch is a plus 

• Willing to work from our office in Zwijnaarde  

What we offer
 

At Sentea, you will work in a growing deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technology based on silicon photonics.
 

You will have the opportunity to shape the software of cutting-edge photonic read-out systems and help turn advanced technology into reliable products. As part of a small, multidisciplinary team, you will have a varied role covering software architecture, embedded development, algorithms and validation, working closely with photonics and hardware engineers from concept to field deployment.

Are you fascinated by numbers and looking for a broad accounting role in an international environment (shared service center)? Do you want to expand your knowledge and gradually grow in your responsibilities? Then this opportunity might be just right for you!
 

For an international organization active in the automotive sector, we are looking for a motivated Accountant to strengthen the finance team.
 

Role
 

As an Accountant, you will have a varied range of tasks and will be responsible for the accounting of one of the European entities. You will get the chance to further develop your accounting knowledge and will gradually become involved in the various closing activities.
 

Your responsibilities include, among other things:
 
 

• You are responsible for daily accounting operations, including processing supplier and customer accounting and bank reconciliations. 

• You process purchase and sales invoices. 

• You assist with the monthly closings. 

• You help prepare and consolidate the quarterly figures. 

• You ensure the correct and accurate recording of financial transactions. 

• You support the preparation of periodic financial reporting. 

• You contribute to internal and external audits. 

• You check the VAT returns. 
 

• You hold a bachelor's degree in accounting or finance. 

• You are either a motivated recent graduate or have a few years of relevant work experience. 

• You are interested in working in an international financial environment or shared service center. 

• You are a real team player, but can also work independently. 

• You take initiative, work proactively and pay close attention to accuracy. 

• Knowledge of SAP, SAP S/4HANA or IFRS is a plus. 

• You have a very good command of English, both spoken and written, and a good basic knowledge of Dutch.

This Junior HR Assistant position gives the opportunity to support core HR processes, from recruitment coordination to employee administration and onboarding. It's the ideal first step for someone who wants to develop strong HR skills and grow within a dynamic, people‑focused environment.

Client Details

Our client is an international and people‑oriented company based in Brussels. They are known for their strong company culture, internal mobility, and commitment to developing talent. To support their growing HR department, they are looking for an enthusiastic Junior HR Assistant ready to discover the world of Human Resources.

Description

As a Junior HR Assistant, you will support the HR team across a variety of tasks, giving you a broad introduction to the field. Your responsibilities will include:

• Assisting with the recruitment process: job postings, screening CVs, scheduling interviews
• Supporting the onboarding of new employees
• Handling HR administration: contracts, personnel files, absences, certificates
• Preparing HR documents and ensuring updated employee data
• Helping with payroll preparation by collecting and verifying information
• Participating in HR projects such as employer branding, training coordination, or wellbeing initiatives
• Being a point of contact for employees, providing clear and friendly support

• You graduated in HR, Psychology, Office Management, Business, or a related field
• Eager to start your career and develop strong HR skills
• Fluent in French and/or Dutch, with a good command of English
• Skilled in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)
• Organized, communicative, and service‑minded
• Proactive, eager to learn, and comfortable handling confidential information
• A real team player who enjoys working with people

Are you passionate about chemistry and eager to take your laboratory skills to the next level? Would you enjoy working with advanced testing equipment, exploring innovative materials and learning new techniques in a professional R&D environment?

You will enjoy a varied laboratory position, receive specialised training and benefit from an attractive salary package with excellent additional benefits!

 
• 
 
Perform functional laboratory tests on newly developed chemical formulations and materials.

 
 
• 
 
Carry out photolithographic processes in a cleanroom environment, including coating, exposure and development of silicon wafers.

 
 
• 
 
Inspect coatings and patterns using techniques such as microscopy and thickness measurements.

 
 
• 
 
Conduct material characterisation tests, including tensile testing, adhesion testing, thermal analysis and chemical compatibility testing.

 
 
• 
 
Perform analytical tests using techniques such as FTIR, UV-VIS, viscosity measurements and DSC.

 
 
• 
 
Prepare and filter chemical formulations when required.

 
 
• 
 
Analyse, document and report test results, including statistical data.

 
 
• 
 
Perform basic maintenance on laboratory equipment and follow established safety procedures.

 

 
• Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Laboratory Technology or equivalent through relevant experience.
 
• Excellent command of Dutch and English.
 
• 
 
A strong interest in laboratory research, materials testing and chemical applications.

 
 
• 
 
Accurate, analytical and attentive to detail.

 
 
• 
 
Reliable, disciplined and comfortable working according to established procedures.

 
 
• 
 
Able to work both independently and as part of a technical team.

 
 
• 
 
Eager to learn new laboratory techniques and develop your technical expertise.

jobs.occupation: Coordinator Internal Sales | Brecht | Vast Contract
jobs.description:
Internal Sales Coördinator 

Are you an experienced people manager who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-paced operational environment? Do you combine strong leadership skills with a hands-on approach to order management, backlog management and customer service?

For an international and dynamic organization, I am looking for an Internal Sales Coördinator to lead a team of four employees.
In this role, you will be close to both the people and the operation. You will coach and develop your team, set priorities, monitor performance and ensure that customers and internal stakeholders receive clear and timely follow-up.

Your responsibilities 

 
• Lead, organize, motivate and coach a team of 4 employees on a daily basis. 
 
• Oversee order and backlog management and ensure customer service enquiries are handled efficiently. 
 
• Set priorities and distribute the workload evenly across the team. 
 
• Monitor team performance, operational metrics and KPIs, and take action where needed. 
 
• Identify training and development needs and provide ongoing coaching. 
 
• Conduct regular one-to-one meetings and performance evaluations. 
 
• Listen to team members' feedback and support them in resolving challenges or conflicts. 
 
• Create sufficient space for team members to contribute to improvement projects alongside their daily responsibilities. 
 
• Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve escalations and ensure clear communication regarding priorities, progress and expected deliverables. 
 
• Provide management with feedback on operational challenges and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 
• Contribute to a positive and collaborative working environment and organize team-building activities. 

Who are we looking for?
For this position, I am looking for someone who knows how to lead and develop people while maintaining a strong overview of the operational priorities. 

 
• You have several years of experience in a leadership or coordinating position, ideally within sales operations, order management or customer service. 
 
• You have proven people management experience and enjoy coaching, motivating and developing team members. 
 
• You have experience with backlog management and are strong at setting priorities and maintaining overview. 
 
• You are an excellent coordinator and communicator who can effectively manage expectations with different stakeholders. 
 
• You are comfortable monitoring KPIs and using them to drive team performance. 
 
• You have strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 
• You remain calm and effective in a dynamic environment and know how to manage competing priorities. 
 
• You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively. 
 
• You have solid computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office, CRM systems and SAP. 
 
• You are fluent in English. Additional languages are an asset, but not a requirement. 
 
• Experience with data modelling and data management tools is considered an advantage. 
 
• You can depend on your own transportation, as the workplace is not accessible by public transport.

For a leading utilities client in Brussels, we are looking for an experienced EndPoint Engineer to strengthen the EndPoint Management team. This position offers the opportunity to work in a complex enterprise environment while contributing to the ongoing modernization of the workplace ecosystem.

You will be involved in both operational and project-based activities, supporting a fleet of approximately 2,500 endpoints serving 1,500 users. The role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical issues while also helping organizations transition towards modern EndPoint management and cloud-based solutions.
Your responsibilities

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex Windows EndPoint incidents and service requests

• Support SCCM/MECM operations including software packaging, deployments, patch management and Windows image maintenance

• Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate repetitive tasks and improve operational efficiency

• Contribute to modern workplace initiatives involving Intune, Autopilot, Entra ID and Conditional Access

• Assist with staging, deployment and lifecycle management activities across the EndPoint landscape

• Share knowledge with colleagues and actively contribute to continuous improvement initiatives

• 3+ years of experience in Windows EndPoint Management

• Strong troubleshooting skills within Microsoft Windows environments

• Hands-on experience with SCCM / MECM

• Strong PowerShell scripting capabilities

• Experience with, or a strong interest in, Intune, Autopilot and Entra ID

• Knowledge of VDI environments is considered a plus

• Fluent in Dutch, French and English
